note: _ambitio_ – retinue, entourage; Begleitung, Gefolge. This is a special meaning of _ambitio_. Rönsch, p. 522; Kaulen, p. 13.

_et dissiliit Ionathas_, [et qui cum eo erant, in Iordanem,] _et transnataverunt ad eos Iordanem_ – and Jonathas jumped [and those who were with him, into the Jordan] and they swam over the Jordan to them. The words set between brackets are absent from the Weber/Gryson text, but included in the Clementina. Both versions of the text are problematic and require emendation. The NVg has: _Et dissiliit Ionathas et, qui cum eo erant, in Iordanem et transnataverunt in ulteriora; et non transierunt ad eos Iordanem_ – and Jonathas jumped together with those who were with him, into the Jordan, and swam to the other side; and they (i.e., the enemy) did not cross the Jordan to them.
